name: Fuwano Nagi
source:
The protagonist of the story. He lived in an orphanage in Sugara District, but after earning the "One's Gift," he now attends Ougen Academy. Although he is blunt and never shows kindness to others, he cherishes the people who he recognizes as family and friends more than himself.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://selectoblige.com/character_sub]official website[/url]]
